summary: AgencyProfileHistory tracks, displays, and retrieves historical actions performed on an agency's profile, including actor details and action specifics. It provides formatted output for user interface display and database searching.
purpose: To maintain an audit/history of agency profile changes, including details of who performed the actions, what actions were performed, when, and the relevant fields and sections of the profile affected. Provides UI controls for displaying this history and mechanisms for searching/filtering records.

workflows.name: Display Agency Profile History
steps: ObjectDataSource selects historical records based on AgencyID and session info.
Records are formatted for display in GridView.
UI controls (Button, Label, GridView) allow navigation and viewing.
User details and actions are retrieved and formatted for tooltips.

workflows.name: Search Agency Profile History
steps: AgencyProfileHistorySearch method receives AgencyID, SessionAgencyID, and session object.
Parameters are passed for filtering results.
Records are parsed and mapped to AgencyProfileHistory objects.

business_rules: If UserSession is null, cancel data selection.
Use alternate language fields if session specifies.
If ByUserSysAdmin is false and ByUserID does not match ByOriginalUserID, format output as HSPnet Support Team.
Show phone details only if available.
validations: AgencyID input must match the selected agency.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: Concatenates agency and initials for unique user identifier.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted: Generates tooltip with detailed user/action info.
conditions: Alternate language fields are used if session.UseAltLanguageFields is true.
Support Team attribution if ByUserSysAdmin is false and user ID mismatch.
system_behavior: Fetches historical action records for given AgencyID.
Displays user action details and formatting.
Cancels record selection if session is absent.
Retrieves UI controls for display and navigation.
dependencies: UI Controls (ASP.NET WebForms: ObjectDataSource, GridView, Button, Label)
exceptions: Database reader failures return empty record list.
content_gaps: No explicit UI markup or stored procedure code provided.
Audit log content details (exact field changes and values) are not shown.
No error handling details for failed DB or UI actions beyond session null checks.
